Lemma 1 (Lemma 3.1 of Xu and Balakrishnan (2012)). Let F be a distribution function with density f supported on (0, ∞) such that f(e^x) is log concave in x ∈ R. Let G1, . . . , Gn be distribution functions with densities g1, . . . , gn supported on (0, ∞) such that F ≤* Gi for each i = 1, . . . , n. Then F ≤* Σ_{i=1}^n pi Gi for pi > 0 such that Σ_{i=1}^n pi = 1.

conclusion.direction: F <=_* Σ pi Gi (mixture preserves star ordering)
